description: Add UX enhancements and polish to authentication flows: loading states during API calls, password visibility toggle, improved error messaging, and resend OTP cooldown timer. These enhancements improve user experience and prevent common issues like double-submission and unclear feedback.
steps: Read current src/pages/Login.jsx and src/pages/Register.jsx to understand existing error handling and form submission logic.

Add loading states to src/pages/Login.jsx: Add isLoading state (boolean). Set isLoading=true when submitting credentials or OTP. Set isLoading=false when response received (success or error). Disable submit buttons when loading. Change button text to 'Sending...' or 'Verifying...' during loading. Show loading indicator (spinner or text).
Add loading states to src/pages/Register.jsx: Same pattern as Login - isLoading state, disable buttons during submission, change button text to indicate loading.

Add password visibility toggle to src/pages/Login.jsx: Add showPassword state (boolean, default false). Change password input type to {showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}. Add eye icon button next to password field. Toggle showPassword on button click.
Add password visibility toggle to src/pages/Register.jsx: Same implementation as Login page.

Update src/styles/Login.css: Add styles for loading states (disabled button styling, loading text/spinner), eye icon button (position absolute inside input field on right side, cursor pointer, hover effects).
Update src/styles/Register.css: Add same loading and password visibility styles as Login.css for consistency.

Improve error messaging in src/pages/Login.jsx: Parse backend error responses from err.response?.data?.message. Handle specific error cases: invalid credentials, invalid OTP, expired OTP, network errors. Display errors in prominent red alert box. Clear errors when user starts typing or submits form again.

Improve error messaging in src/pages/Register.jsx: Parse backend errors for: email already exists, validation failures, OTP errors, session expired. Display specific field validation errors if backend provides them. Clear errors appropriately.

Add resend OTP cooldown to src/pages/Login.jsx: Add resendCooldown state (number, seconds remaining, default 30). Start countdown after OTP is sent (use setInterval). Disable Resend OTP button while cooldown > 0. Update button text to show countdown: 'Resend OTP (23s)' or 'Resend OTP'. Clear interval on component unmount to prevent memory leaks. Reset cooldown to 30 when resend is clicked.
Add resend OTP cooldown to src/pages/Register.jsx: Same cooldown implementation as Login page.

Test all enhancements: (1) Submit login form -> button shows 'Sending...' and is disabled during API call. (2) Click password eye icon -> password becomes visible, click again -> hidden. (3) Enter invalid credentials -> specific error message displayed. (4) After OTP sent -> Resend button disabled for 30 seconds with countdown displayed. (5) After 30 seconds -> Resend button enabled. (6) Click Resend -> new OTP sent, cooldown resets. (7) Test same behaviors in registration flow.
acceptance_criteria: Login and Register forms show loading states (disabled buttons, loading text) during API calls
Password fields have eye icon toggle to show/hide password text
Error messages are specific and helpful (invalid credentials, email exists, invalid OTP, etc.)
Errors are displayed in prominent red alert boxes
Errors clear when user starts typing in form fields or resubmits
Resend OTP button is disabled for 30 seconds after sending OTP
Resend OTP button shows countdown timer during cooldown period
Resend OTP button is re-enabled after 30 seconds
Clicking Resend OTP triggers new OTP and resets cooldown
No memory leaks from intervals (cleanup on unmount)
All enhancements work consistently in both Login and Register pages
verification: Test loading states: Submit login form -> verify button text changes to 'Sending...' and button is disabled. After response received -> button re-enabled.
Test password visibility: Click eye icon in password field -> password text becomes visible. Click again -> text hidden.

Test error messages: Enter wrong email/password -> verify specific error message like 'Invalid username/email or password'. Try to register with existing email -> verify error like 'User with email already exists'. Enter wrong OTP -> verify 'Invalid or expired OTP' message.

Test resend cooldown: Submit login credentials to get to OTP step -> verify Resend OTP button shows 'Resend OTP (30s)' and is disabled. Wait for countdown -> button text updates each second. After 30 seconds -> button shows 'Resend OTP' and is enabled. Click Resend OTP -> new OTP sent, countdown resets to 30 seconds.
Test same enhancements in Register flow: loading states, password toggle, error messages, resend cooldown all work.
Test cleanup: Navigate away from Login/Register pages during cooldown -> no console errors about memory leaks or intervals.
Check browser console for no errors or warnings during any UX interactions.
